name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: caregiver_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value for the caregiver's age in years, recorded now.
when_unknown: Set to null if the caregiver's age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined at the current time.
when_value: Set to the caregiver's age in years as recorded at the current time.

name: patient_is_able_to_speak_english
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is able to speak English.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is able to speak English.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not able to speak English.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is able to speak English.

name: patient_is_able_to_read_english
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is able to read English.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is able to read English.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not able to read English.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is able to read English.

name: caregiver_is_able_to_speak_english
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the caregiver of the patient is able to speak English.
when_true: Set to true if the caregiver of the patient is able to speak English.
when_false: Set to false if the caregiver of the patient is not able to speak English.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the caregiver of the patient is able to speak English.

name: caregiver_is_able_to_read_english
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the caregiver of the patient is able to read English.
when_true: Set to true if the caregiver of the patient is able to read English.
when_false: Set to false if the caregiver of the patient is not able to read English.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the caregiver of the patient is able to read English.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_asthma_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever been diagnosed with asthma in their medical history.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever been diagnosed with asthma at any point in their medical history.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never been diagnosed with asthma at any point in their medical history.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever been diagnosed with asthma.

name: patient_has_finding_of_asthma_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever had a clinical finding of asthma in their medical history.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever had a clinical finding of asthma (including a doctor's statement) at any point in their medical history.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never had a clinical finding of asthma at any point in their medical history.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever had a clinical finding of asthma.

name: patient_has_finding_of_difficulty_breathing_inthepast12months
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has had a clinical finding of difficulty breathing in the past 12 months.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has had a clinical finding of difficulty breathing (breathing problems) at any time in the past 12 months.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not had a clinical finding of difficulty breathing (breathing problems) at any time in the past 12 months.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has had a clinical finding of difficulty breathing in the past 12 months.

name: duration_of_active_inhaled_corticosteroid_prescription_in_weeks
meaning: Numeric value representing the duration in weeks of the patient's active inhaled corticosteroid prescription.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined how many weeks the patient has had an active prescription for inhaled corticosteroids.
when_value: Set to the number of weeks the patient has had an active prescription for inhaled corticosteroids.

name: patient_has_finding_of_inhaled_steroids_use_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has an active prescription for inhaled corticosteroids.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has an active prescription for inhaled corticosteroids.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have an active prescription for inhaled corticosteroids.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has an active prescription for inhaled corticosteroids.

name: asthma_symptom_days_in_past_14_days_value_recorded_in_days
meaning: Numeric variable indicating the number of separate days in the past 14 days on which the patient experienced asthma symptoms (including wheezing, shortness of breath, tightness in the chest, or cough). Unit: days.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined how many days the patient experienced asthma symptoms in the past 14 days.
when_value: Set to the number of separate days in the past 14 days on which the patient experienced asthma symptoms (including wheezing, shortness of breath, tightness in the chest, or cough).

name: asthma_symptom_nighttime_awakening_days_in_past_14_days_value_recorded_in_nights
meaning: Numeric variable indicating the number of separate nights in the past 14 days on which the patient woke up because of asthma symptoms (including wheezing, shortness of breath, tightness in the chest, or cough). Unit: nights.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined how many nights the patient woke up because of asthma symptoms in the past 14 days.
when_value: Set to the number of separate nights in the past 14 days on which the patient woke up because of asthma symptoms (including wheezing, shortness of breath, tightness in the chest, or cough).

name: activity_limitation_days_due_to_asthma_or_wheezing_or_tightness_in_chest_or_cough_in_past_14_days_value_recorded_in_days
meaning: Numeric variable indicating the number of separate days in the past 14 days on which the patient had to slow down or stop play or usual activities because of asthma, wheezing, tightness in the chest, or cough. Unit: days.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined how many days the patient had to slow down or stop play or usual activities for these reasons in the past 14 days.
when_value: Set to the number of separate days in the past 14 days on which the patient had to slow down or stop play or usual activities because of asthma, wheezing, tightness in the chest, or cough.

name: school_days_missed_due_to_asthma_or_wheezing_or_tightness_in_chest_or_cough_in_past_14_days_value_recorded_in_days
meaning: Numeric variable indicating the number of separate days in the past 14 days on which the patient missed school because of asthma, wheezing, tightness in the chest, or cough. Unit: days.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined how many days the patient missed school for these reasons in the past 14 days.
when_value: Set to the number of separate days in the past 14 days on which the patient missed school because of asthma, wheezing, tightness in the chest, or cough.

name: asthma_rescue_medicine_days_used_in_past_14_days_value_recorded_in_days
meaning: Numeric variable indicating the number of separate days in the past 14 days on which the patient used any asthma rescue medicine (quick relief medicine). Unit: days.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined how many days the patient used asthma rescue medicine in the past 14 days.
when_value: Set to the number of separate days in the past 14 days on which the patient used any asthma rescue medicine (quick relief medicine).

name: patient_has_caregiver_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a caregiver.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a caregiver.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a caregiver.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a caregiver.

name: patient_lives_in_residence_of_caregiver_now

when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not live in the residence of the caregiver.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently lives in the residence of the caregiver.

name: patient_has_been_diagnosed_with_asthma_ever
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever been diagnosed as having asthma.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever been diagnosed as having asthma by a healthcare professional.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never been diagnosed as having asthma by a healthcare professional.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever been diagnosed as having asthma.

name: doctor_has_stated_patient_has_asthma_ever
meaning: Boolean indicating whether a doctor has ever stated that the patient has asthma.
when_true: Set to true if a doctor has ever stated that the patient has asthma.
when_false: Set to false if a doctor has never stated that the patient has asthma.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether a doctor has ever stated that the patient has asthma.

name: patient_has_had_breathing_problems_in_past_12_months
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has had breathing problems at any time in the past 12 months.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has had breathing problems at any time in the past 12 months.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not had breathing problems at any time in the past 12 months.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has had breathing problems in the past 12 months.

name: patient_duration_of_active_inhaled_corticosteroid_prescription_in_weeks
meaning: Numeric value representing the duration in weeks of the patient's active inhaled corticosteroid prescription.
when_unknown: Set to null if the duration in weeks of the patient's active inhaled corticosteroid prescription is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the number of weeks the patient has had an active prescription for an inhaled corticosteroid.

name: patient_has_active_inhaled_corticosteroid_prescription_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has an active prescription for an inhaled corticosteroid.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has an active prescription for an inhaled corticosteroid.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have an active prescription for an inhaled corticosteroid.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has an active prescription for an inhaled corticosteroid.

name: exacerbation_count_in_past_1_year@@requiring_oral_systemic_corticosteroids
meaning: Numeric variable indicating the number of exacerbations the patient has had in the past 1 year that required oral systemic corticosteroids.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined how many exacerbations in the past 1 year required oral systemic corticosteroids.
when_value: Set to the number of exacerbations the patient has had in the past 1 year that required oral systemic corticosteroids.

name: emergency_department_visit_count_due_to_asthma_in_past_1_year
meaning: Numeric variable indicating the number of emergency department visits due to asthma the patient has had in the past 1 year.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined how many emergency department visits due to asthma the patient has had in the past 1 year.
when_value: Set to the number of emergency department visits due to asthma the patient has had in the past 1 year.

name: hospitalization_count_due_to_asthma_in_past_1_year
meaning: Numeric variable indicating the number of hospitalizations due to asthma the patient has had in the past 1 year.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined how many hospitalizations due to asthma the patient has had in the past 1 year.
when_value: Set to the number of hospitalizations due to asthma the patient has had in the past 1 year.

name: urgent_medical_care_visit_count_due_to_asthma_in_past_1_year

when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined how many urgent medical care visits due to asthma the patient has had in the past 1 year.
when_value: Set to the number of urgent medical care visits due to asthma the patient has had in the past 1 year.

name: eligibility_exacerbation_or_ed_or_hosp_or_urgent
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient meets at least one of the four inclusion criteria in the past year.
when_true: Set to true if the patient meets at least one of the following in the past year: (1) at least 2 exacerbations requiring oral systemic corticosteroids, (2) at least 2 emergency department visits due to asthma, (3) at least 1 hospitalization due to asthma, or (4) at least 2 urgent medical care visits due to asthma.
when_false: Set to false if the patient meets none of the above criteria in the past year.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient meets any of the above criteria in the past year.

name: patient_has_finding_of_asthma_inthehistory@@stated_by_doctor
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the clinical finding of asthma was stated by a doctor.
when_true: Set to true if the clinical finding of asthma was stated by a doctor at any point in the patient's medical history.
when_false: Set to false if the clinical finding of asthma was not stated by a doctor at any point in the patient's medical history.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether a doctor stated the clinical finding of asthma.

name: patient_asthma_control_test_score_value_recorded_now_withunit_none
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's current Asthma Control Test score (unitless).
when_unknown: Set to null if no such score is recorded now or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured value if a numeric Asthma Control Test score is recorded for the patient now.

name: family_of_patient_is_currently_involved_in_asthma_management_intervention_above_usual_care

when_false: Set to false if the patient is unable to complete all study procedures independently, without assistance.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is able to complete all study procedures independently, without assistance.

name: family_is_currently_involved_in_asthma_management_intervention_above_and_beyond_usual_care

when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the family of the patient is currently involved in an asthma management intervention above and beyond usual care.

when_false: Set to false if no family member of the patient is currently involved in an asthma management intervention that is above and beyond usual care.
